market_view: GIFT Nifty is roughly flat near 26,000 after two up days, and foreign buying continues (about Rs 1.28 lakh crore over 20 days). I expect a range-bound open, with money still rotating into IT and other large-caps that have lagged.

picks.reason: Nifty IT has risen four sessions in a row on foreign buying and a rotation out of the US AI trade, and Infosys gained 4.7% yesterday on 1.5 times normal volume. It is still 30% below its 52-week high, so it has more room to catch up than HCLTech, which jumped 6.4%.

Torrent Pharma had the heaviest relative volume in the universe yesterday (4.7 times normal) on a 2.5% gain, and it is up 8.9% over five days. It closed only 2% below its 52-week high, so a breakout looks likely.

Realty was the second-best sector yesterday, and Lodha rose 4.9% on twice normal volume. With a 25% gain over 20 days and a close 4% below its high, the stock shows strong momentum heading into a new high.
